actual_employee_count.name: actual_employee_count
actual_employee_count.description: Count of employees with a current assignment.

approved_position_count.name: approved_position_count
approved_position_count.description: Count of positions authorized in the approved organizational establishment.

budgeted_position_count.name: budgeted_position_count
budgeted_position_count.description: Count of positions for which people budget is available.

filled_position_count.name: filled_position_count
filled_position_count.description: Count of positions currently occupied by employees.

vacant_position_count.name: vacant_position_count
vacant_position_count.description: Count of positions whose current status is Vacant.

frozen_position_count.name: frozen_position_count
frozen_position_count.description: Count of positions currently frozen for hiring.

vacant_approved_position_count.name: vacant_approved_position_count
vacant_approved_position_count.description: Approved positions that do not currently have an employee assignment.

funded_vacant_position_count.name: funded_vacant_position_count
funded_vacant_position_count.description: Budgeted positions that are currently vacant or frozen.

unfunded_vacant_position_count.name: unfunded_vacant_position_count
unfunded_vacant_position_count.description: Approved vacant or frozen positions without available position budget.

headcount_variance.name: headcount_variance
headcount_variance.description: Difference between actual employees and approved positions.

net_approved_headcount_gap.name: net_approved_headcount_gap
net_approved_headcount_gap.description: Difference between approved positions and actual employee count. A positive value means understaffing, while a negative value means overstaffing.

net_budgeted_headcount_gap.name: net_budgeted_headcount_gap
net_budgeted_headcount_gap.description: Difference between budgeted positions and actual employee count. A positive value means funded staffing capacity remains available.

vacancy_rate_percentage.name: vacancy_rate_percentage
vacancy_rate_percentage.description: Vacant approved positions as a percentage of approved positions.

headcount_utilization_percentage.name: headcount_utilization_percentage
headcount_utilization_percentage.description: Actual employee count as a percentage of approved positions.

actual_full_time_equivalent.name: actual_full_time_equivalent
actual_full_time_equivalent.description: Sum of assignment capacity for current employee assignments.

overstaffed_employee_count.name: overstaffed_employee_count
overstaffed_employee_count.description: Number of employees above the approved position count.

included_in_approved_headcount_count.name: included_in_approved_headcount_count
included_in_approved_headcount_count.description: Count of current employees included in the approved Headcount establishment.

excluded_from_approved_headcount_count.name: excluded_from_approved_headcount_count
excluded_from_approved_headcount_count.description: Count of current employees not included in the approved Headcount establishment.

approved_headcount_inclusion_percentage.name: approved_headcount_inclusion_percentage
approved_headcount_inclusion_percentage.description: Percentage of current employees included in approved Headcount.

average_tenure_months.name: average_tenure_months
average_tenure_months.description: Average employee tenure in months for the selected workforce.

average_years_in_company.name: average_years_in_company
average_years_in_company.description: Average years employees have worked in the company.

total_actual_people_cost.name: total_actual_people_cost
total_actual_people_cost.description: Total salary, benefits, recruitment, training and overtime cost incurred.

remaining_people_budget.name: remaining_people_budget
remaining_people_budget.description: Approved people budget remaining after actual people cost.

budget_utilization_percentage.name: budget_utilization_percentage
budget_utilization_percentage.description: Actual people cost as a percentage of approved people budget.

approved_salary_and_benefits_budget.name: approved_salary_and_benefits_budget
approved_salary_and_benefits_budget.description: Approved budget for employee salaries and benefits.

training_and_development_budget.name: training_and_development_budget
training_and_development_budget.description: Approved budget for employee training and development.

workforce_contingency_budget.name: workforce_contingency_budget
workforce_contingency_budget.description: Approved budget reserved for unplanned workforce costs.

actual_salary_cost.name: actual_salary_cost
actual_salary_cost.description: Actual salary cost incurred during the reporting period.

actual_training_cost.name: actual_training_cost
actual_training_cost.description: Actual employee training and development cost.

joiner_count.name: joiner_count
joiner_count.description: Count of employees joining the organization.

leaver_count.name: leaver_count
leaver_count.description: Count of employees leaving the organization.

transfer_in_count.name: transfer_in_count
transfer_in_count.description: Count of employees transferred into a department.

transfer_out_count.name: transfer_out_count
transfer_out_count.description: Count of employees transferred out of a department.

monthly_net_workforce_change.name: monthly_net_workforce_change
monthly_net_workforce_change.description: Net monthly workforce change after joiners, leavers and transfers.

employees_available_for_work.name: employees_available_for_work
employees_available_for_work.description: Employees available to work on the selected activity date.

employees_on_approved_leave.name: employees_on_approved_leave
employees_on_approved_leave.description: Employees recorded as being on approved leave.

total_overtime_hours.name: total_overtime_hours
total_overtime_hours.description: Total overtime hours recorded for the selected scope.

workforce_availability_percentage.name: workforce_availability_percentage
workforce_availability_percentage.description: Employees available for work as a percentage of actual employees.

daily_open_position_count.name: daily_open_position_count
daily_open_position_count.description: Open positions recorded in the daily workforce activity snapshot.

daily_critical_open_position_count.name: daily_critical_open_position_count
daily_critical_open_position_count.description: Critical open positions recorded in the daily workforce activity snapshot.

vacancy_age_in_days.name: vacancy_age_in_days
vacancy_age_in_days.description: Number of calendar days a position has remained vacant.

average_vacancy_age_in_days.name: average_vacancy_age_in_days
average_vacancy_age_in_days.description: Average number of days that the selected currently open positions have remained vacant.

overdue_vacancy_count.name: overdue_vacancy_count
overdue_vacancy_count.description: Currently open vacancies whose target fill date is earlier than the workforce reporting date.

average_time_to_fill_in_days.name: average_time_to_fill_in_days
average_time_to_fill_in_days.description: Average actual number of days taken to fill completed vacancies.

long_open_vacancy_count.name: long_open_vacancy_count
long_open_vacancy_count.description: Currently open vacancies older than 90 calendar days.

critical_open_position_count.name: critical_open_position_count
critical_open_position_count.description: Open positions with High or Critical position criticality.

open_exception_count.name: open_exception_count
open_exception_count.description: Count of currently open Headcount Management exceptions.

critical_exception_count.name: critical_exception_count
critical_exception_count.description: Count of open Headcount exceptions classified as Critical.

warning_exception_count.name: warning_exception_count
warning_exception_count.description: Count of open Headcount exceptions classified as Warning.

active_rule_count.name: active_rule_count
active_rule_count.description: Count of Headcount Management rules effective on the reporting date.

demand_to_approved_headcount_gap.name: demand_to_approved_headcount_gap
demand_to_approved_headcount_gap.description: Difference between demand-driven staffing need and approved positions.

expected_employee_exits.name: expected_employee_exits
expected_employee_exits.description: Probability-weighted expected exits produced by the existing Attrition prediction service.

employee_category.name: employee_category
employee_category.description: Regular, contract, internship, or another employee category.

headcount_inclusion_category.name: headcount_inclusion_category
headcount_inclusion_category.description: Category under which an employee is included in workforce Headcount.

included_in_approved_headcount.name: included_in_approved_headcount
included_in_approved_headcount.description: Whether an employee is included in approved Headcount.

organizational_unit.name: organizational_unit
organizational_unit.description: Team or other organizational hierarchy unit.

employment_type.name: employment_type
employment_type.description: Permanent, contract, internship or other type.

work_mode.name: work_mode
work_mode.description: On-site, hybrid or remote work arrangement.

position_status.name: position_status
position_status.description: Filled, Vacant or Frozen position status.

position_criticality.name: position_criticality
position_criticality.description: Low, Medium, High or Critical position priority.

recruitment_stage.name: recruitment_stage
recruitment_stage.description: Current hiring stage for a vacancy.

movement_type.name: movement_type
movement_type.description: Join, Leave, Promotion or Transfer movement.
